content.text: If you purchase a product or register for an account through one of the links on our site, we may receive compensation. Learn more > Before a potential matchup in the NBA Playoffs, the Celtics and Heat will face off one more time in the regular season.Boston clinched a playoff berth before the end of March and reached 50 wins for the fifth consecutive season. Now, the Celtics are focused on building momentum down the stretch and keeping their hold on the No. 2 seed in the Eastern Conference standings. The Heat have been struggling as of late, dropping seven of their last nine games. Miami was able to beat Philadelphia in its most recent outing, though, behind strong performances from Tyler Herro and Bam Adebayo.Here is everything you need to know about Celtics vs. Heat, including TV and streaming options for Wednesday's game.How to watch Celtics vs. Heat tonight: TV channel, live streamTV channel: ESPNLive stream: ESPN appCeltics vs. Heat will air nationally on ESPN. The game will also be available to stream on the ESPN app.Now you can watch ESPN without cable.
